bp_inj_mis_lsb.description: TERM 2's side-to-side mismatch, against the ratified Offset row (<= 2 LSB, README.md#target-specification), re-taken against the extracted core. Measured at the f = 0 level, where both sides sit at V_cm and the ideal sampled step is exactly zero -- so the differential top plate at the end of the sample IS the mismatch of the two sides' bottom-plate switch injection, with nothing subtracted. NULL-CONTROL CAVEAT (inherited from the schematic record): this is the harness's nominal, ZERO-MISMATCH case (no Monte Carlo device variation), so the two sides are electrically identical circuits at f = 0 -- device-to-device mismatch is #14's Monte Carlo domain, not this deck's.

samp_inl_l1_lsb.description: The SAMPLE's own nonlinearity, endpoint-fitted across the input range, against the ratified INL row (< 1 LSB), re-taken against the extracted core. This is the signal-DEPENDENT part of everything that happens during acquisition and turn-off -- input-switch injection, the voltage dependence of C_par, and the drive network -- and it is the part DR-0014's cancellation does NOT remove. The endpoint gain is removed by construction (that is what an endpoint fit does) because a pure scale factor on the sampled value cancels against the same scale factor on the DAC step; a bow does not.

hold_l4_lsb.description: END-TO-END LIVENESS: the deck must actually sample. At f = +0.90 the ideal held differential top plate is -921.6 LSB (negative because DR-0014 inverts the residue). The window is wide because the held value carries the FULL k = C_arr/(C_arr+C_par) attenuation -- which is precisely the term DR-0014 shows cancels from the comparator's decision, so it must not be bounded tightly here as if it were an error.

notes: TERM 1 IS MEASURED WITHOUT A REFERENCE SIMULATION, and that is the point of the schedule -- see sim/dr0014-sampling/testbench/tb.json's identical note. This manifest's Group A/C wiring is per layout/adc-top/parasitics/gen_extracted_dr0014_sampling_tb.py, not re-derived.
TERM 4 IS MEASURED AT EXAGGERATED MISMATCH ON PURPOSE, same rationale and same 10/30/100 fF levels as the schematic manifest -- see sim/dr0014-sampling/testbench/tb.json's identical note.

GROUPS B AND D ARE NOT MEASURED HERE. Group B (fourth-leg settling A/B) needs the deck-local DR-0011 three-leg cell, which was never drawn or extracted (the converter as built has no three-leg cell). Group D (isolated T-gate R_on) needs a standalone adc_tgate instance at forced voltage; klt extract was run at ADC_TOP/ADC_BLOCK granularity only, so no individually-addressable T-gate exists in the extracted netlist. Both are structural gaps, not omissions of convenience -- see layout/adc-top/parasitics/gen_extracted_dr0014_sampling_tb.py's module docstring.
V_REF AND V_cm ARE IDEAL SOURCES IN THIS DECK, same as the schematic manifest -- reference droop is measured, with the real network, by sim/adc-inl-dnl/ and sim/adc-power/'s own extracted-core runs.
THE CONTROLS ARE IDEAL EDGES, NOT THE CONTROLLER'S -- same rationale as the schematic manifest: sim/sar-logic-functional/ verifies the rung-1 controller produces exactly this schedule.
